prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: SECOND alternate color version of the existing FitLife mural for a side-by-side comparison.
Primary request: Recolor ONLY the attached flat mural artwork into the FitLife website brand palette. Keep the complete original illustration, layout and typography intact. This is a strict color remap, not a redesign.
Input image: the attached colorful restored FitLife mural is the sole edit target and composition reference.
Invariants: Preserve exactly the entire composition, both athletes, their faces, bodies, poses, rope, barbell and weight plates, all angular polygon geometry and shapes, every geometric shard, the black background, all text wording, all text positions, sizes and typography, the central brushstroke silhouette, and the same 16:9 framing. Keep crisp, detailed high-quality 2D vector-style polygonal painting. Do not add or remove elements.
Allowed palette ONLY: near-black/charcoal #0d0c0b, brand crimson #f32643, warm brand red #ea3f2e, white/off-white, and neutral grays for tonal shading. Absolutely remove every yellow, orange-gold, blue, teal, purple and green hue. Any colored shape must now be one of these reds, whites, grays or black.
Color directions: Change central golden-yellow paint swipe to solid strong brand crimson red #f32643 while retaining its irregular brush edges. Central exact wording remains "FIT LIFE" on line one and "FITNESS" on line two: FIT and FITNESS in crisp off-white, LIFE in deep near-black #0d0c0b for distinct strong contrast on the crimson swipe. Keep the original italic athletic letterforms. No red letters against red brushstroke. Recolor the surrounding word cloud in white/off-white, saturated brand red and neutral gray with excellent readability on the dark base. Athletes retain all polygon facets and detailed anatomy; use white and gray highlights, saturated brand-red midtones and deep black shadows. All dynamic geometric shards and spotlight motifs become red, white and neutral gray. Barbell plates become deep charcoal with red accents and white/gray highlights. Rope becomes white and gray with black shadows.
Mood: premium bold dark sports mural, unified black/red/white identity, rich saturated reds. Not a grayscale filter and not a red translucent filter. Individually recolor actual polygon facets cleanly with intentional tonal contrast.
Output: same landscape approx 16:9 framing, highest available quality and resolution. Opaque edge-to-edge artwork only.
Avoid: new illustration, modified layout, altered poses, misplaced or corrupted text, new logo, room, floor, gym objects, website UI, borders, margins, yellow, gold, orange-gold, blue, teal, purple, green, and unapproved colors.
visual_inspection: Confirmed red, black, white and gray palette; yellow, blue and teal removed; main brand typography and composition preserved.
